metadata.title: Zefiro SRL
metadata.description: Official website of Zefiro Net. Secure, state-of-the-art telecommunications infrastructure.

hero.sottotitolo: We accelerate the deployment of 5G networks across Italy. Providing world-class wholesale infrastructure to connect rural areas and bridge the digital divide.

manifesto.sottotitolo: We believe in a seamlessly connected Italy without geographical disparities. We work behind the scenes to make digitization a tangible reality for everyone.

sedi.sottotitolo: We operate across Italy with strategic direction and operational centres to guarantee the highest network efficiency.

documenti.sottotitolo: In line with our commitment to transparency, we make all corporate, financial, and governance records available.
documenti.nessunDocumento: No documents found in this category.

lavoraConNoi.sottotitolo: Join the joint venture accelerating Italy's digital future. We are looking for talents ready to make an impact.
lavoraConNoi.valore1Desc: We experiment with cutting-edge 5G technologies to connect even the most remote regions of Italy.
lavoraConNoi.valore2Desc: We build infrastructure respecting the environment and local landscapes, fostering equitable growth.
lavoraConNoi.valore3Desc: Our team brings together the foremost experts in wholesale telecommunications.
lavoraConNoi.candidaturaDesc: Send us your resume and tell us how you can contribute to the Zefiro Net vision.
lavoraConNoi.candidaturaNote: Our HR team will carefully review every application.

homepage.chiSiamoSottotitolo: Bridging the digital divide by delivering 5G and ultra-broadband networks across 70% of the national territory, mainly in rural and sparsely populated areas. With around 7,000 active mobile sites and towers, we enable an open, shared wholesale infrastructure of excellence.
